column1: # Live beta matrix (plan §4). One row per live check; beta-matrix.sh runs each on every display.
# expect: pass, or xfail while the named defect is open. When a ticket fixes the defect,
# flip its row to pass in the same change; an unexpected pass (XPASS) fails the run.

column4: check
Area capture of the pattern; Copy gives the exact 320×180 pattern (pattern --verify)
A press inside the Selection doesn't move the pattern window, and Esc still cancels
A pointer on the display's top pixel row starts a Selection with an Origin display; Esc cancels it
Window capture of a pattern window gives exactly that window (pattern --verify-full)
Full-screen capture gives the exact display (pattern --verify-full)
Four steady wheel steps stitch the scroll page exactly (meter blocks)
A 40-line flick stitches exactly or shows Slow down; never a short or wrong image
Page Down scrolls the page while a scrolling capture runs
400×500 capture: after an arrow at row 450 and a label at row 40, Copy has ink in both bands and nowhere between
A label typed as v2.1 $4.99 -10% reads back exactly through Copy Text
Solid redaction over the red quadrant, Blur and Magnify on top: pattern --verify-redacted
Crop to the middle half: the copied image has the crop's size
At the default editor width Done, Copy and Save are on screen, not in the toolbar overflow
Copy Text on the pattern caption puts its text on the clipboard
Copy Text on a capture with no text leaves the clipboard unchanged, shows no alert, and says "No text found" on the Thumbnail
Two pending Thumbnails don't overlap
After ⌘⇧2, the Thumbnail's C key copies (keys reach the Thumbnail, not the frontmost app)
History row Copy puts the newest capture on the clipboard (pattern --verify)
History row Save writes one export whose name carries the date
History Delete with the capture's Thumbnail still open asks first, then succeeds
A cancelled editor drag leaves History and drag staging unchanged
